name: Elfy and Toy Elf picture workflow
picture_standard: This is for a kids' co-op escape game for ages 8 and up: friendly, funny and a little spooky, never scary. For a FRONT view one picture is attached: another character from the same game - use it ONLY as a guide to the style, proportions and level of detail; design a completely NEW character from this prompt (different face, hair and clothes). For a BACK view one picture is attached: the same character seen from directly behind, same pose, every color the same as the front. Clean, simple 3D cartoon toy style: every area one smooth, flat, solid color, with no texture at all - no fabric grain, no knit, no stitching, no dirt, no folds or wrinkles painted on, no shading or shadows painted on, nothing see-through and nothing glowing. Simple rounded shapes, slightly chunky proportions, big clear eyes. Small details as simple solid shapes, close to the body - nothing thin or long sticking out. No logos, brand marks, emblems, swooshes, stripes on shoes, printed words or graphics. Not like any famous character from a film, cartoon or game. Full body standing in an A-pose: arms straight and angled clearly down and away from the body with a clear gap between each arm and the body all the way down, hands open, legs slightly apart, feet flat. Centered and filling the whole height, nothing cropped. Plain flat light-gray background, even soft light, no floor shadow. One character only, no text.
instructions: Process assets in table order; include the complete standard and Picture in every prompt.
Inspect and attach every reference in array order.
Save and verify each front before generating its matching back; use that saved front as the back reference.
Create missing output folders. Preserve existing artwork unless replacement is explicitly requested.
